text: The fringe visibility of a two-beam interference pattern is V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁+I₂). Maximum visibility (V = 1) requires that:
choices: the two beams have orthogonal polarizations
one beam is much stronger than the other
the two beams have equal intensities
the two beams have different frequencies
explanation: V = 2√(I₁I₂)/(I₁+I₂) reaches its maximum of 1 only when I₁ = I₂. Orthogonal polarizations or different frequencies destroy interference entirely (V → 0), and a large intensity imbalance drives V well below 1.
